mapper.select: select count(distinct(t.device_code)) as deviceCountTotal, count(distinct case when t.device_status = 1 then t.device_code end) as devCountOffline, count(distinct case when t.device_status = 0 then t.device_code end) as devCountOnline from vm_order_devices o inner join vm_device_info_t t on o.device_code = t.device_code inner join vm_channel_info_t c on c.device_code = t.device_code where o.delete_flag = '0' and t.delete_flag = '0' and o.ord_status in (0,1,2) ${param.dataScope}

select count(distinct(t.channel_code)) as channelCountTotal, count(distinct case when t.channel_status = 0 then t.channel_code end) as channelCountOnline, count(distinct case when t.channel_status = 1 then t.channel_code end) as channelCountOffline from vm_order_devices o inner join vm_channel_info_t t on o.device_code = t.device_code where o.delete_flag = '0' and t.delete_flag = '0' and o.ord_status in (0,1,2) ${param.dataScope}
